title: Algebra of Bivariate-Bicycle Surface Codes
summary: We relate the properties of bivariate-bicycle-surface (BBS) codes, constructed from a pair of bivariate polynomials over a finite field, to the number and location of their common roots in the extension field. The number of roots $(x,y)$ with finite, non-zero coordinates -- counted with algebraic multiplicity -- determines the dimension of the codes. This dimension is invariant under monomial automorphisms of the Laurent polynomial ring.
